pr_title: Make IntoSystemConfigs::into_configs public API (visible in docs)
pr_body:
`IntoSystemConfigs::into_configs` function is public, but hidden from documentation. This PR makes it visible.

Fixes #10622.

issue_context.title: Make IntoSystemConfigs::into_configs public
comments: Generally on board with this. I wouldn't expect this to be particularly stable, but I'm okay if this is exposed for advanced users.

review_comments: This only makes it visible in the docs; it's already accessible in user code (just tested it in one of my Bevy projects).
